title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Counter Options and Incidental Fees Price List
content:
The rental partner's counter options and incidental fees under Rental Vehicle Coordination are priced per class as follows; only the damage waiver differs between classes.

## Price list

| Rental class | Additional driver (USD per day) | Spouse or domestic partner drives free | Child seat (USD per day) | Child seat most per rental (USD) | Navigation unit (USD per day) | Roadside protection (USD per day) | Damage waiver (USD per day) | Supplemental liability (USD per day) | Toll service fee (USD per toll day) | Toll service fees most per rental (USD) | Smoking cleaning fee (USD) | Pet cleaning fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Rental | 12.99 | Yes | 13.99 | 69.95 | 9.99 | 6.99 | 29.99 | 16.99 | 5.95 | 29.75 | 250.00 | 150.00 |
| Compact Rental | 12.99 | Yes | 13.99 | 69.95 | 9.99 | 6.99 | 29.99 | 16.99 | 5.95 | 29.75 | 250.00 | 150.00 |
| Intermediate Rental | 12.99 | Yes | 13.99 | 69.95 | 9.99 | 6.99 | 31.99 | 16.99 | 5.95 | 29.75 | 250.00 | 150.00 |
| Full-Size Rental | 12.99 | Yes | 13.99 | 69.95 | 9.99 | 6.99 | 33.99 | 16.99 | 5.95 | 29.75 | 250.00 | 150.00 |
| Standard SUV Rental | 12.99 | Yes | 13.99 | 69.95 | 9.99 | 6.99 | 36.99 | 16.99 | 5.95 | 29.75 | 250.00 | 150.00 |
| Minivan Rental | 12.99 | Yes | 13.99 | 69.95 | 9.99 | 6.99 | 38.99 | 16.99 | 5.95 | 29.75 | 250.00 | 150.00 |

## Meaning of each price

- **Additional driver**: the additional driver fee per rental day; **spouse or domestic partner drives free** states whether the renter's spouse or domestic partner drives free.
- **Child seat**: the child seat price per rental day, and the most charged for one child seat per rental.
- **Navigation unit**, **roadside protection**, **damage waiver** and **supplemental liability**: the price of each per rental day.
- **Toll service fee**: the toll service fee per rental day on which a toll is used, plus the tolls themselves; the most toll service fees charged per rental.
- **Smoking** and **pet cleaning fees**: the cleaning fee when a rental is returned smelling of smoke, or with pet hair.

## Hypothetical price readings

- A child seat kept for 3 rental days is priced at 3 days of 13.99 USD, 41.97 USD, which is under the 69.95 USD most charged per seat; kept for 6 rental days it would come to 83.94 USD and is held at 69.95 USD.
- Toll service fees on 7 toll days would come to 41.65 USD and are held at 29.75 USD, the tolls themselves being added at cost.
